race.comment: Tricky with so many on debut. SHAH JAHAN (4) was fair fresh when fourth over 1000m at Bendigo on very heavy going. He can improve quickly and is well placed to feature. SAINTLY DANCER (13) is a first-starter by St Mark's Basilica out of Thinkyoucandance. Coming along nicely leading into this, placing in a couple of recent jump-outs. Watch for any market confidence. MANAHI (10) on debut. By the sire Sword Of State and from the stakes-winning mare Windermere. In the placings at her most recent trial and worth consideration here. SCORCHING BEAUTY (14) resumed at Pakenham Synthetic over 1100m last time out and finished ninth. Fitter for that run and look to the betting.
